_comment: Standalone English vocabulary explainers (no false-friend trap). 'word' is the English word/phrase; 'looks_like' is left empty so the player skips the trap row; 'actually' is the plain-English definition, shown with the check tag; 'vo' is the Bulgarian voice-over line explaining the word. 'prompt' is the ComfyUI image prompt; deliberately objects/places, never people, since the model is weak at hands. DEMO DECK — a handful of example entries so a fresh clone runs. Replace this file with your own, or drop a private deck beside it as '<name>.local.json' (gitignored), which takes precedence.

items.vo: Meticulous описва човек, който внимава за всеки детайл. Часовникар е meticulous.
items.prompt: a watchmaker's bench with tiny gears laid out in perfect rows, tweezers, warm focused lamp light

items.vo: Resilient значи устойчив — нещо, което се възстановява бързо след удар.
items.prompt: a small green sapling growing through a crack in dry cracked earth, dramatic backlight

items.actually: open to more than one meaning
items.vo: Ambiguous означава двусмислен — нещо, което може да се разбере по няколко начина.
items.prompt: a weathered wooden signpost with arrows pointing opposite directions, foggy crossroads, muted light

items.vo: Scarce значи оскъден — има го съвсем малко. Водата е scarce в пустинята.
items.prompt: a single drop of water falling from a rusted tap into an empty metal basin, harsh dry light

items.actually: honest and direct, even when awkward
items.vo: Candid значи откровен — казваш истината направо, дори да е неудобно.
items.prompt: an open empty notebook with a pen beside a window, plain honest morning light, minimal composition
